name: G-Rough
summary: A Design Hotels house on Piazza di Pasquino, just off Piazza Navona, in a historic palazzo.
description: G-Rough is a member of Design Hotels at Piazza di Pasquino 69, a few steps from Piazza Navona. The hotel’s own account describes a historic palazzo you enter through a wine bar rather than a formal lobby, and a Roman founder’s idea of an apartment you are handed the key to. It is on this list because it looks like the trip, not because it is a bargain. Breakfast was included in the Junior Suite rate Booking.com showed for 10–11 November 2026.
facts: The hotel describes a historic palazzo entered through a wine bar
